findings.detail: Rendered methodology states the analysis was exploratory and restricts model, topic, seed count, and checkpoint scope to recorded artifacts.
Rendered methodology and discussion explicitly limit two-seed scope to declared seed-paired contrast families and separate single-seed and instrument-specific readings.
Rendered motivation states that absorption is held-out premise specialization, not a belief measure.
Rendered methodology states belief and action contrasts were netted against matched off-topic controls and not interpreted as causal mediation.
Rendered methodology states raw belief/action checkpoint figures are diagnostic rather than netted transfer estimates.
Rendered methodology states fixed tables are authoritative for numerical estimates and confidence intervals rather than prose.
The rendered paragraphs report 0.0076 for software architecture at seed 42 with matched off-topic control and all arms gated, and preserve the three-seed disagreement qualification.
The rendered paragraphs report 0.0122 at seed 7 and identify it as a seed-matched-control replicate within the three-seed scope.
The rendered paragraphs report -0.0034 at seed 123 with a seed-matched control and all five arms gated, and preserve the machinery-term qualification.
The rendered paragraphs report -0.0173 at seed 42 and -0.0025 at seed 7 for 4B LoRA, state that netting subtracts this quantity, and state the intervals do not overlap.
The rendered paragraphs report the sign change from -0.0031 to 0.0156 for 8B LoRA and preserve both opposite-sign and nonoverlapping-interval qualifications.
The rendered paragraphs report -0.0053 and -0.0049 under full fine-tuning and state that the intervals overlap, unlike every LoRA control family.

The rendered paragraphs report 0.0342 at step 36 after three epochs with the same arms and control, one seed, all seven arms gated, and the control passing at 0.802.

The rendered paragraphs report the recorded explicit-stance positive-control belief contrast as 0.3111 at step 24 and state it is an instrument positive control with lower token dose and no inferred interval.
The rendered paragraphs report 0.2167 at step 36, identify it as the same positive control one epoch later, state it began to decay while the evidence cell rose, and state no interval was inferred.

The rendered paragraphs report 0.1517 at 4B for an explicit-stance positive control in a dose-matched model comparison.

The rendered paragraphs report 0.0011 at 4B, state that its interval straddles zero, and prohibit a conduction ratio.
